sources.title: 90-Degree Push-Up
sources.finding: Elite handstand-to-bent-arm-planche skill; requires freestanding handstand, deep HSPU, bent-arm planche strength and dynamic balance.

sources.title: FITNESSGRAM 90° Push-Up Instructions
sources.finding: Uses the same label for a conventional cadence push-up reaching 90-degree elbow flexion.

records.reason: Canonical identity must be disambiguated before capability classification; two materially different exercises share the name.

fieldApplication.reason: Two materially different exercise identities share the label; no field value is defensible until identity is disambiguated.

sources.title: Knees Ab Wheel progression
sources.finding: Progression chain places Ab Wheel Eccentrics after ramp rollout and before full standing rollout; eccentrics control the descent from standing.

sources.title: Ab Wheel Exercises progression guide
sources.finding: Standing ab-wheel eccentrics are step 6 immediately before full standing rollout and are performed by rolling out without returning.

sources.title: Crunch
sources.finding: ACE rates Crunch Beginner and specifies controlled supine spinal flexion with feet, tailbone and low back supported.

sources.title: Foam Roll Adductors
sources.finding: NASM describes the technique as appropriate for all fitness levels; hands support the body while slow controlled rolling is performed.

sources.title: Advanced Tuck Back Lever
sources.finding: Requires controlled tucked back lever, straight-arm strength, shoulder control, sufficient shoulder mobility, body-line awareness and controlled entry/exit.

sources.title: Overcoming Gravity 2 preview
sources.finding: Places Advanced Tuck Back Lever at level 4 in a structured back-lever progression, after tuck and before straddle.

sources.title: Assisted Pistol Squat
sources.finding: Most accessible pistol progression: full-ROM single-leg squat using arms/support for assistance, progressively reduced.

sources.title: Assisted Pull-up
sources.finding: Band assistance preserves the standard pull-up movement pattern while reducing required force; assistance is adjusted to current strength.

sources.title: Australian Pull-Up
sources.finding: Low-difficulty scalable horizontal pull with heels supported; body angle adjusts load while trunk maintains a rigid line.

sources.title: Back Lever
sources.finding: Elite straight-arm horizontal skill; final position in a long progression, with substantial straight-arm load, demanding shoulder extension and strict body-line control.

sources.title: Assisted Hamstring Curl
sources.finding: Assisted Nordic-style curl uses upper-body support to regulate difficulty; prescribed as a low-rep strength progression.

sources.title: Assisted Leg Raise
sources.finding: Library classifies Assisted Leg Raise as Intermediate; supported lying execution trains hip flexors/quadriceps and core pattern.

sources.title: Assisted Single-Leg Squat
sources.finding: Suspension trainer assists balance, squat depth and thigh load during a controlled single-leg squat.

sources.title: Back Extension Apparatus
sources.finding: ACE notes back extensions can use bodyweight, dumbbells or machine and are appropriate for healthy adults of all fitness levels.

sources.title: Bulgarian Split Squat
sources.finding: Advanced unilateral lower-body movement explicitly challenging single-leg strength, balance and stability.

sources.title: Back Lever Pullout
sources.finding: Advanced transition from horizontal back lever to inverted hang with straight elbows and rigid body line.

sources.title: Back Squat
sources.finding: ACE classifies barbell Back Squat as Advanced and requires controlled below-knee depth with straight back and chest up.

sources.title: Stability Ball Bridge
sources.finding: Supine bridge with heels on a stability ball; hips rise while the unstable ball increases stabilization demand.

sources.title: Ball Shoulder Stretch
sources.finding: Supported kneeling stretch rolling an exercise ball forward only to a comfortable gentle shoulder/upper-back stretch.

sources.title: Band-Assisted Planche
sources.finding: Band reduces load but preserves planche body line; assistance is progressively reduced toward unassisted planche.

sources.title: Banded Biceps Curl
sources.finding: Beginner resistance-band isolation curl with fixed elbows and controlled return.

sources.title: Banded Chest Press
sources.finding: Beginner-friendly seated resistance-band press; simple bilateral compound push.

sources.title: Banded Deadlift
sources.finding: Band-resisted barbell deadlift requires coordinated hip/knee extension, neutral spine and increasing lockout resistance.

sources.title: Banded Rear Delt Row
sources.finding: Standing anchored-band high-elbow row targeting rear delts and upper back with controlled return.

sources.title: Band External Rotation
sources.finding: Beginner prehab/rehab rotator-cuff movement using light resistance and fixed elbow.

sources.title: Banded Front Raise
sources.finding: Included in a beginner shoulder workout; controlled standing band raise to eye level.

sources.title: Banded Lateral Raise
sources.finding: Beginner isolation shoulder exercise performed standing on a band with controlled raise/lower.

sources.title: Banded Lying Leg Extension
sources.finding: Supine band-resisted alternating leg extension with core braced and controlled range.

sources.title: Band Triceps Extension
sources.finding: Beginner elbow-extension isolation drill with controlled upper-arm position.

sources.title: Banded Unilateral Triceps Extension
sources.finding: Single-arm band triceps extension with stable staggered stance and isolated elbow extension.

sources.title: Banded Upright Row
sources.finding: Beginner resistance-band strength exercise: stand on band and pull to upper chest.

sources.title: Bar Pull-Up Eccentrics
sources.finding: Progression immediately before strict pull-up; requires repeated controlled ~5-second negative lowers.

sources.title: Barbell Bent Leg Dead Lift
sources.publisher: Anatomy for Strength and Fitness Training
sources.finding: Compound closed-chain barbell pull classified intermediate to advanced, requiring coordinated knee/hip extension.

sources.title: Barbell Biceps Curl
sources.finding: ACE barbell library classifies Bicep Curl as Intermediate.

sources.title: Barbell Glute Bridge
sources.finding: Weighted progression of bodyweight glute bridge; stable floor-supported hip extension with adjustable load.

sources.title: Standing Shoulder Press
sources.finding: ACE classifies standing barbell shoulder press as Advanced; requires standing bracing and controlled overhead press.

sources.title: Barbell Row
sources.finding: ACE describes barbell row as Advanced and notes core stabilization demand.

sources.title: Barbell Shrug
sources.finding: Catalog difficulty 2/5; simple standing barbell shrug with controlled vertical shoulder movement.

sources.title: Standing Shoulder Press
sources.finding: ACE classifies standing barbell shoulder press as Advanced.

sources.title: Behind-the-Neck Press
sources.finding: Requires substantial shoulder extension/abduction and stability; even advanced lifters are advised to use care.

sources.title: Behind-the-Neck Pull-Up
sources.finding: Advanced bodyweight pull requiring unusual shoulder rotation range and controlled hanging execution.

sources.title: Bench Dips
sources.finding: Intermediate bodyweight triceps exercise; scalable with foot position and requires controlled shoulder positioning.

sources.title: Barbell Bench Press
sources.finding: Standard loaded chest press used as benchmark in ACE chest-exercise research; stable bench-supported compound press.

sources.title: Bend and Reach
sources.finding: Slow preparation drill developing squat-and-reach ability and moving hips/spine through full flexion.

sources.title: Bent-Arm Bent-Body Press to Handstand
sources.finding: Structured gymnastics progression lists this as Level 5 bent-arm press-to-handstand skill.

records.exerciseName: Bent Arm Pull Up to Back Lever

sources.title: Bent Arm Pull Up to Back Lever
sources.finding: Explicitly classified Advanced in the back-lever progression after back lever/pullout.

sources.title: Bent-Arm Straight-Body Press to Handstand
sources.finding: Structured gymnastics progression lists bent-arm straight-body press to handstand as Level 8.

sources.title: Bent Knee Push-up
sources.finding: ACE classifies the kneeling push-up as Beginner.

sources.title: Bent-Knee Sit-Up
sources.finding: Classic floor core exercise using controlled trunk/hip flexion from a stable supine base.

sources.title: Bent-Over Lateral Raise
sources.finding: Intermediate rear-deltoid isolation exercise requiring a stable hip-hinged torso and controlled raise.

sources.title: Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Row
sources.finding: Basic fundamental supported unilateral row with torso kept motionless.

sources.title: Bent-over Row
sources.finding: ACE classifies barbell bent-over row as Advanced and requires maintained flat-back hip hinge.

sources.title: Bicycle Crunch
sources.finding: Bodyweight core movement combining trunk rotation/flexion with alternating leg motion.

sources.title: Bear Crawls
sources.finding: ACE places bear crawls in bodyweight performance training, requiring coordinated quadrupedal locomotion.

sources.title: Bastards
sources.finding: Progression beyond a difficult burpee combining squat thrust, full push-up and explosive tuck jump; described as very hard full-body exercise.

sources.title: Bench Step
sources.finding: Alternating bench step-up targets quads, hamstrings and glutes and explicitly improves balance.

sources.title: Bent Leg Good Morning
sources.publisher: Anatomy for Strength and Fitness Training
sources.finding: Barbell bent-leg good morning is explicitly classified intermediate to advanced and uses a controlled hip hinge.

sources.title: Bodyweight/Air Squat
sources.finding: ACE bodyweight interval guidance places air squats in an entry-level muscular-endurance workout.

sources.title: Box Dip
sources.finding: Stable box-supported bodyweight dip: hands fixed behind body, lower to about 90-degree elbows, press back up.

sources.title: Box Headstand Pushup
sources.finding: Level-2 handstand-pushup progression; feet elevation shifts more bodyweight onto hands and requires prior solid pike headstand pushup.

sources.title: Burpees
sources.finding: High-intensity full-body sequence combining squat, plank, push-up and explosive jump; seven familiar movements but substantial strength/cardio demand.

sources.title: Bodyweight Crunches
sources.finding: Beginner floor-supported abdominal crunch with short controlled spinal flexion.

sources.title: Bodyweight Modified Push-Ups
sources.finding: Beginner kneeling push-up progression with reduced bodyweight loading.

sources.title: Bodyweight Sit-Ups
sources.finding: Classic stable supine bodyweight trunk-flexion exercise.

sources.title: Cable Front Raise
sources.finding: Beginner-friendly cable isolation movement with stable cable path and controlled raise.

sources.title: Cable Rope Crunch
sources.finding: Weighted kneeling spinal-flexion exercise with adjustable cable resistance.

sources.title: Cable Upright Row
sources.finding: Standing cable row with controlled path; lighter load recommended for stability and shoulder comfort.

sources.title: Calf Raise
sources.finding: ACE classifies machine calf raise as Beginner.

sources.title: Bridge
sources.finding: ACE classifies floor glute bridge as Beginner; stable supine hip extension with abdominal bracing.

sources.title: Cable Crossover
sources.finding: Beginner standing cable chest fly with staggered stance and controlled wide arc.

sources.title: Cable Trap Shrug
sources.finding: Beginner cable isolation shrug with feet planted and straight vertical shoulder motion.

sources.title: Cable Unilateral Triceps Pressdown
sources.finding: Beginner cable isolation extension; unilateral constant-tension triceps work.

sources.title: Cable Deadlift
sources.finding: Beginner compound cable hip/knee extension with flat-back setup and controlled lowering.

sources.title: Boxer Shuffle
sources.finding: Beginner rhythmic bodyweight footwork drill requiring rapid weight shifts, agility and coordination.

sources.title: Candlestick
sources.finding: Basic gymnastics roll from standing/squat into shoulder-supported candlestick; develops core strength, body awareness and control.

sources.title: Bicycle
sources.finding: Beginner no-equipment bicycle crunch combining alternating leg motion with trunk rotation.

sources.title: Bodyweight Leaning Side Abdominal
sources.publisher: Anatomy for Strength and Fitness Training
sources.finding: Intermediate-to-advanced side-support bodyweight exercise requiring whole-body stabilization in a straight line.

sources.title: Calf Stretch
sources.finding: Passive standing calf stretch using staggered stance and ground support, held gently 20–30 seconds.

sources.title: Barbell Triceps Press
sources.publisher: Anatomy for Strength and Fitness Training
sources.finding: Barbell compound press explicitly classified intermediate to advanced; controlled pressing with elbows kept in.

sources.title: Cable Rotational Oblique Twist
sources.finding: Standing cable rotational twist uses coordinated torso, hip and foot rotation with controlled diagonal cable path.
